description: This file defines the GuzzleHttp Client class, which implements HTTP client functionality with methods for sending HTTP requests asynchronously and synchronously, managing configuration options, and handling request options. It serves as a core part of the Guzzle HTTP client library for PHP.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: The Client class implements the Guzzle HTTP client, providing methods to send HTTP requests synchronously and asynchronously, manage configuration options, and handle request preparation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Client with optional configuration, setting default handler, base URI, and default headers.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Magic method to handle dynamic request methods like get, post, etc., calling the appropriate request method or async method.

methods.name: sendAsync
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request asynchronously with the provided request object and options.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request synchronously, waiting for the response.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request as specified by the RequestInterface object.

methods.name: requestAsync
methods.description: Creates and sends an asynchronous HTTP request with the specified method, URI, and options.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Creates and sends a synchronous HTTP request with the specified method, URI, and options.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the current client configuration or a specific option.

methods.name: buildUri
methods.description: Combines base_uri and other URI configurations to produce a complete URI.

methods.name: configureDefaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration options for the client, including headers, proxy environments, and cookies.

methods.name: prepareDefaults
methods.description: Merges default request options with provided options, handling special cases like headers and body.

methods.name: transfer
methods.description: Executes the request transfer process using the handler stack, returning a promise.

methods.name: applyOptions
methods.description: Applies various request options to a given PSR-7 request object, modifying headers, body, query, and auth as needed.

methods.name: invalidBody
methods.description: Constructs an exception for invalid body parameter usage.
